timing: immediately after manipulation, before source-monitoring task

state_decentering.instrument: MPoD-s (Metacognitive Processes of Decentering — State; Hanley et al. 2020)
state_decentering.item_text_policy: copyrighted item text is NOT reproduced in project files; authorized administration and scoring access required (PREREG BLOCKER)

selective_success_rule.requirement_1: decentering exceeds active control on the prespecified MPoD-s estimand
selective_success_rule.requirement_2: conditions fall within prespecified equivalence margins on relaxation, distress, effort, credibility/expectancy, engagement
selective_success_rule.equivalence_note: ordinary non-significance is NOT evidence of equivalence

equivalence_margin_status: CANDIDATE (±10 on 0–100 VAS) — must be challenged in final review before preregistration
failure_rule: an observed criterion shift is not interpretable as decentering-specific if the selective-success rule fails
